source: North Carolina State Center for Health Statistics, Vital Statistics Volume 2: Leading Causes of Death, county tables (xlsx workbooks, original files saved under sources/nc_schs_vital_stats_v2)
note: Counts are published for every county at every size, including 0-9 (no cell suppression stated for counts; death RATES are flagged with an asterisk when the numerator is small). Single-year counts 2019-2023; each year file also carries the 5-year total ending that year (2015-2019 ... 2019-2023). Cause groupings follow the NCHS leading-cause list. Keys otherinj, mvc, breastcancer, colorectalcancer, prostatecancer, lungcancer, hiv, septicemia have no MortalGIS measure yet.
